steps.note: Inspect. The records in scope are listed, and any skipped file is reported.
Partition. The records are cut into chunks, each read on its own.
Map. Each chunk is checked against this skill's rules, one chunk at a time.
Order. Each policy review is placed by its next review date.
Verify. Each cited line is re-read, and a finding that does not hold is dropped.
Report. Status: draft for the owner to review. It is not a decision.

outcome.verdict: 2 policy reviews need a source or a date

findings.title: Review with no source
findings.fix: Name the reason the review is due

findings.title: Next date does not follow from the interval
findings.fix: Recompute the date from the interval

outcome.notChecked: Regulatory changes not on the list.

example:
Illustrative example: the items and results are made up, not real output.
Summary: 3 findings (2 medium, 1 low).

       Fix: Name the reason the review is due.
[medium] policy-conduct.md:19  Next date does not follow from the interval.
       Fix: Recompute the date from the interval.
[low] policy-whistle.md:26  Policy with no owner.

pros: Checks a review with no source, a next date that does not follow from the interval, and a policy with no owner.
cons: Not checked: Regulatory changes not on the list.
input: The records for this review, as text or CSV
output: A draft report: findings with location, fix and a not-checked list
prompt: Use the rlm-legal-policy-calendar skill on the records for this review.
